response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile senior/staff-level engineer with 15+ years across web, backend, embedded, and distributed systems, plus strong craftsmanship (TDD, CI/CD), open-source leadership, and public teaching experience that maps well to the mentoring and technical-leadership aspects of the role. However, the core requirement — 8+ years shipping production-grade AI/GenAI solutions — is not met; AI exposure appears limited to roughly one year of MCP code generators and agentic tooling at re:cinq. The resume shows no Python, no RAG or vector database work, no LLM evaluation/observability pipelines, and only modest cloud depth (AWS CDK). He could be a strong platform engineer on an AI team, but is a stretch for a Staff GenAI Forward Deployed Engineer role.
strengths: 15+ years senior/staff engineering across many stacks; strong TypeScript/Node.js
Hands-on MCP server/agentic tooling experience, directly relevant key technology
Proven mentoring, workshops, talks, and open-source project leadership
concerns: Little evidence of production AI/GenAI systems; far short of 8 years
No RAG, vector database, LLM evaluation, or multi-agent framework experience
Python absent from skills; cloud experience limited and no customer-facing delivery/consulting record

key_factors.factor: RAG, vector DB, and agent framework gaps
Staff-level engineering breadth and MCP/agent tooling exposure
